en:
Bumper Switch

Introduction

The bumper class is used with the Bumper Switch, a mechanical switch that completes a circuit when pressed, allowing the robot to detect presses and releases.

Class Constructor

bumper(
  triport::port &port );

Class Destructor

Destroys the bumper object and releases associated resources.

virtual ~bumper();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
port triport::port& The 3-Wire Port that the Bumper Switch is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X, where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A).

Example

// Create a bumper instance in Port A
bumper BumperA = bumper(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

Member Functions

The bumper class includes the following member functions:

  • pressing — Returns whether the Bumper Switch is being pressed.
  • pressed — Registers a function to be called when the Bumper Switch is pressed.
  • released — Registers a function to be called when the Bumper Switch is released.

Before calling any bumper member functions, a bumper instance must be created, as shown below:

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Bumper Switch configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a bumper instance in Port A
bumper BumperA = bumper(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

pressing

Returns whether the Bumper Switch is currently being pressed. This can be used to check if the robot bumps into other objects.

Available Functions

int32_t pressing();

Parameters

This function does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

Returns an int32_t indicating whether the Bumper Switch is being pressed.

  • 1 — The Bumper Switch is being pressed.
  • 0 — The Bumper Switch is not being pressed.

pressed

Registers a function to be called when the Bumper Switch is pressed.

Available Functions

void pressed( void (* callback)(void) );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
callback void (*)(void) A pointer to a function that will be called when the bumper is pressed.

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Examples

Define the callback function (outside of int main())

// Display a message when bumper is pressed
void BumperPressed() {
  Brain.Screen.print("Bumper pressed");
}

Register the callback inside int main()

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run BumperPressed when the value of the Bumper Switch is pressed.
  BumperA.pressed(BumperPressed);
}

released

Registers a function to be called when the Bumper Switch is released.

Available Functions

void released( void (* callback)(void) );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
callback void (*)(void) A pointer to a function that will be called when the bumper is released.

Return Values

This function does not return a value.

Examples

Define the callback function (outside of int main())

// Display a message when bumper is released
void BumperReleased() {
  Brain.Screen.print("Bumper released");
}

Register the callback inside int main()

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run BumperReleased when the value of the Bumper Switch is released.
  BumperA.released(BumperReleased);
}
zh:
碰撞开关

概述

bumper类与缓冲开关配合使用，缓冲开关是一种机械开关，按下时可形成电路，使机器人能够检测按下和释放。

构造函数

bumper(
  triport::port &port );

析构函数

销毁bumper对象并释放关联资源。

virtual ~bumper();

参数

参数 类型 说明
port triport::port& Bumper Switch 连接的三线端口，写作Brain.ThreeWirePort.X或ExpanderName.X，其中X是端口号（例如Brain.ThreeWirePort.A或Expander1.A）。

示例

// Create a bumper instance in Port A
bumper BumperA = bumper(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

成员函数

bumper类包含以下成员函数：

  • pressing— 返回缓冲器开关是否被按下。
  • pressed— 注册按下缓冲开关时要调用的函数。
  • released— 注册释放缓冲器开关时要调用的函数。

在调用任何bumper成员函数之前，必须创建一个bumper实例，如下所示：

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Bumper Switch configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a bumper instance in Port A
bumper BumperA = bumper(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

pressing

返回当前是否按下了 Bumper Switch。这可用于检查机器人是否碰撞到其他物体。

函数重载

int32_t pressing();

参数

该函数不接受任何参数。

返回值

返回int32_t指示 Bumper Switch 是否被按下。

  • 1— 缓冲开关被按下。
  • 0— 缓冲开关未被按下。

pressed

注册按下保险杠开关时要调用的函数。

函数重载

void pressed( void (* callback)(void) );

参数

参数 类型 说明
callback void (*)(void) 指向按下保险杠时将调用的函数的指针。

返回值

此函数无返回值。

示例

定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

// Display a message when bumper is pressed
void BumperPressed() {
  Brain.Screen.print("Bumper pressed");
}

在int main()内部注册回调函数

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run BumperPressed when the value of the Bumper Switch is pressed.
  BumperA.pressed(BumperPressed);
}

released

注册释放保险杠开关时要调用的函数。

函数重载

void released( void (* callback)(void) );

参数

参数 类型 说明
callback void (*)(void) 指向释放保险杠时将调用的函数的指针。

返回值

此函数无返回值。

示例

定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

// Display a message when bumper is released
void BumperReleased() {
  Brain.Screen.print("Bumper released");
}

在int main()内部注册回调函数

int main() {
  /* vexcodeInit() is only required when using VEXcode.
  Remove vexcodeInit() if compiling in VS Code. */
  vexcodeInit();

  // Run BumperReleased when the value of the Bumper Switch is released.
  BumperA.released(BumperReleased);
}
